lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: No way, an original song?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Where did you even get this...?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I managed to pull it off through some solid outreach.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: What kind of outreach nets you a song?!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: That's a trade secret.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Aren't we on the same team?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Well, the higher you go, the tighter the security gets.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Anyway, this is a solo track, so we'll need to arrange it for a trio.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Prika, think you can handle it?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: Yes, I can.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Wait, you know how to do that?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: It's literally what I majored in.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: In that case, make sure I get the most lines.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: Let me have a look.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: So you're just going to ignore me?
Prika plugs the USB into the computer and checks what's inside.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: S-so, how's it? Is it a good song?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: What's wrong? Is it bad?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Guys... we haven't even heard it yet.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: Boss.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: How much money do we have?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Why do you ask?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: If we don't have the software for this, we can't even open it, let alone edit it.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: It's a custom program made by Tetra Line...

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: ... and it's priced at around 200 million.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: What kind of program costs 200 million?!

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: That's the scary thing about monopolies.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: All right, I'll figure something out.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I know a place I can borrow from. It's called Wow Finance.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Sounds shady as hell!

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: There's something I've been curious about for a while.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: If you were a director at Tetra, how is it that you don't seem to have much money?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: They told me if I was leaving, I had to hand over everything—stocks and all—so I did.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Is that legal?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I was done talking to them, so I just did as I was told and left.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'd rather not say.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: ... Now that I think about it, you've never told us this.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Boss, why'd you leave Tetra?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Honestly, Tetra's an amazing company, like a treasure trove of entertainment.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: That's really not something for kids to worry about.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: All right, cut the chatter. Let's figure this out.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: What's there to worry about? I'll just borrow the money. One call and it's done.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: No, don't even go near those loan sharks.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Do pardon me.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: The door was open. Hope you don't mind.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: ... Who are you?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: ... It's Yoyo.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Yoyo?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: The number-one singer on the charts.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yoyo... what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: If I may.
Yoyo strides in,
eyes locking with Anis for a moment. Then, she passes a USB to Prika, who remains seated at the computer.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Here's the program and manual.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: They're all yours.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Hang on, we don't use pirated software.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Don't be ridiculous.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: It's an unused company account I grabbed. Go ahead, use it.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: Uh... Sweet, thanks?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Don't mention it.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yoyo, why the sudden...?
Yoyo stares straight at Anis.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Anis, mind if we talk for a moment?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Huh? Me?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Yes, you.
Anis looks around, bewildered.
Every face she sees mirrors her own expression.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Uh... Sure.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Let's step outside, shall we?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Wh-why are you staring at me like that?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Oh, I get it now.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: So the charts are settled with fists, huh?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Fine, bring it on. Starting today, I'm number one.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: What exactly are you talking about?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: How the heck am I supposed to know? You don't say anything.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: You don't remember me?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Huh? Remember you? Have we met?
Anis stares at Yoyo's face.
The longer she looks, the more familiar the features seem.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Wait, hold up...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: You're the class president?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: ... Yeah.
Anis jolts, stumbling back in shock.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: What...? Why are you—

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I became a Nikke too, to become a pop star.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: What, you weren't satisfied making my life hell when we were human? You wanna keep it up now that we're Nikkes too?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Look, I'm just trying to live my life here, all right? I'm doing the best I can, and even that's hard enough as it is.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: If you pile one more thing on top of that, I swear I'm gonna lose it.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: So do me a favor and stay the hell out of my life.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: ... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: For the way I treated you back at school. I truly am.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I'm sorry for hurting you, for being cruel.
Yoyo bows deeply as she apologizes.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: You were a thorn in my side.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: You showed up out of nowhere, and it felt like you were taking everything from me. I hated you for it.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Because you had nothing, yet you were taking things from people who had everything.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Hey, that's going a bit too far.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: ... When you became a Nikke after your accident, I heard you were preparing to debut as a pop star.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I begged my father to let me become a Nikke too. I worked myself to the bone just so I could crush you.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: ... But somewhere along the way, I realized something.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Just how hard you'd been working all this time,

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: how desperately you wanted to be loved, and how much effort you put in to earn it.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: When you were the cheer captain, I pretended not to see all those hours you spent practicing and preparing.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I convinced myself you were just taking what should've been mine.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: But once I tried to earn recognition myself, I finally understood

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: how difficult it is to be acknowledged by others,

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: and how much you have to put on the line to make it happen.
Yoyo lifts her head.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I've done a lot of reflecting, and I still am.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: The program and manual... consider them a small gesture from me.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: I'll help however I can from here on out, if you'll let me...

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: ... Will you forgive me?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Are you out of your damn mind?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: If it were you, would you forgive me?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Huh?! Would you?!

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: You bastard, after everything you put me through...!

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: You made me want to die, and now you think one lousy apology makes it all go away?!

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I still wake up in the middle of the night thinking about that day!

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Oh, what? So you turned yourself into a Nikke just to step on me?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: And now you're the chart-topping pop star?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Hah, turns out the Ark's entertainment scene isn't worth shit!

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Anis, I get that you're angry, but don't drag the whole industry into it.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: You're not better than me at a single thing.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: You were the same when we were human. You really think becoming a Nikke suddenly changes that?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Number one? Ha. Seriously? If this is what passes for number one, it must be easy.
Anis glares menacingly at Yoyo.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I'm going to crush you.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I'll grind you into the dirt and show you the difference between us.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I'll stomp you so hard you won't even dare look at me again.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Don't do this.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: We're colleagues chasing the same dream. We should be supporting each other.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: There's no need for us to fight. If we support each other and grow together...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Piss off.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Don't worry, I'm not about to air your dirty laundry, so relax and get lost.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: That's what you're worried about, right? Your precious reputation taking a hit.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Sorry, but I don't play dirty like you.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I'll crush you with pure skill.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Anis... don't do this.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Aaaagh! I said get the hell out!

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: Fine, I'm leaving.

lines.speaker: yoyo
lines.text: See you around.
Yoyo turns and walks away.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Aaaah!

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Agh! AAAAAGH!

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Wait... you're serious?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Yeah, I'm serious.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: My high school nightmare turns out to be a pop star? What is this, some trashy novel plot?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Damn it, how the hell am I supposed to take her down?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: So what do we do about this program?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: ... What do you mean?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: The program she brought. Are we using it or not?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Use it. She's the problem, not the program.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: You won't tell anyone, will you?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Tell them what?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: If word got out that Yoyo used to bully you, the entertainment reporters would have a field day.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Forget it, I don't need to play dirty.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I'll wipe the floor with her.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Hell, I can do it with my eyes closed!

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Well, that was fast.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: How long do you think it'll take to rearrange the piece?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: We got the manual, so I'll pick it up quick.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: One week, tops.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Then our goal is to perform this song

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: on our last day at Meet & Meat.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: The schedule's tight, but can you make it?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: Our first song.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: The very first one we can call our own.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Honestly, I can do this in my sleep.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Well, aren't you confident.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Nervousness won't get you anywhere.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: Everyone, get ready.
The countdown comes through the in-ear monitor.
The stage lights blaze on.
Her vision goes white. When it clears, the audience is a sea of people.
Then the cheers erupt.
The electric jolt nearly knocks Anis off her feet,
but the next instant, it swells into a rush of explosive exhilaration.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: Hello everyone! We're the three shining stars, T.T. STAR!

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: Thank you so much for coming!

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: Everyone, look right here!

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: We're about to shine!

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: All Eyes On Me!
